title: Ordinary single-complex model for pullback of section localization
statement: For continuous u : D ⥤ C, a sheaf ring map a : R ⟶ u_* S, and V : D whose induced slice functor is continuous, termwise module pullback on the slices carries the degree-zero complex R|V[1/t] to the degree-zero complex S|u(V)[1/a(t)]. The isomorphism sends pullback of the localization-unit chain map to ringedSliceLocalizationGenerator. The coefficient localization and slice presentations are [def-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-derived-data] and [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. No derived adjunction or exactness assumption is needed for this ordinary calculation.

proof.text: Over.post u preserves the terminal over-object, so it is final. Its module pullback therefore carries the unit module isomorphically to the unit module. Apply the ordinary adjunction hom equivalence to prove that this isomorphism intertwines multiplication by each section and its image; this reduces sectionwise to multiplicativity of a and its naturality. Use the localizationSheafCoconeIsColimit and localizationSheafMap_step calculations of lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-factor-colimit. Pullback preserves the telescope colimit since it is left adjoint. The unique colimit isomorphism gives an isomorphism of localized module sheaves. The cocone uses the fraction x/t^(n+1); recover the localization unit by multiplication by t followed by its first cocone map, and use the scalar intertwining equation. Finally apply HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex and its naturality to obtain the claimed complex isomorphism and generator equation.
